skills.name: Like Fraction Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract two fractions that already share the same denominator.

skills.name: Unlike Fraction Subtraction
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and subtract fractions that have different denominators.

skills.name: Whole Number Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number parts of mixed numbers or a whole number and a mixed number.

skills.name: Regrouping/Borrowing
skills.definition: Regroup one whole unit into a fraction when the minuend's fractional part is smaller than the subtrahend's fractional part.

skills.name: Improper Fraction Conversion
skills.definition: Convert an improper fraction embedded in a mixed number into standard mixed-number form before performing subtraction.
